### Update Test Status

- **Environment-based**: All context passed via environment variables
- **Version controlled**: Hooks in `.dmux-hooks/` are shared with team
- **Priority resolution**: `.dmux-hooks/` → `.dmux/hooks/` → `~/.dmux/hooks/`
